bivariate_poisson.support_note: Supported only when training residual covariance is positive. A common Poisson component preserves game-specific means.

empirical_residual.support_note: Samples paired centered training residuals with replacement, then rounds/clips scores to nonnegative integers.

negative_binomial.support_note: Method-of-moments overdispersion fitted on training scores only; alpha=0 degenerates to Poisson.
